text:
shreya: Hey team — pen test vendor (RedTeamX) is confirmed for Mon 2027-04-12. Scope includes Prod API, KMS proxy, and RBAC service. Need go/no-go on rolling RBAC changes and evidence handoff plan. Who can own access windows and presigned evidence bundles?

matt: I can own access windows. Quick q: will we create ephemeral assessor roles or temporary Service Account keys? Prefer ephemeral via KMS grants.

erin: KMS grants + scoped IAM role seems right. Need to confirm audit logging retention for the assessment — they may need last 90 days. Current logs forwarded to Splunk for 365d, but we need export path. Also, do we allow read on key metadata?

samir: For remediation tracking: we'll use the vuln-tracker board (project #security/pen-test-2027). I propose priority matrix: P0 (RCE/auth bypass), P1 (privilege escalation), P2 (info leak). Can ops help with retest slots?

ops_lead: Ops can reserve two 2-hour retest windows the week after assessment. Need a list of repro steps + evidence zip posted to presigned S3. Use prefix: s3://redwood-pt-artifacts/rtx/1800123456/

shreya: @ops_lead we'll need presigned URL policy: 7 days expiry, versioned objects, and separate folder per assessor. Also require sha256 checksum file.

sec-bot: Ticket created: SEC-PT-2027-1800123456. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-PT-2027-1800123456 :rotating_light:

matt: For RBAC changes, I suggest a canary window: apply new role bindings to 5% of services, monitor 1hr, rollback if errors > 0.5% 5xxs. How do we capture role-change audit events?

erin: Capture via control-plane audit logs — sample entry: ```{ "event":"iam.bind", "actor":"deploy-bot", "target":"svc/rls", "timestamp":"2027-04-12T10:05:12Z", "changes":"added role evaluator" }``` We'll store in Splunk index=security-audit.

samir: Remediation handoff: devs to attach PR with fix, link to ticket, assign remediation owner, ETA <= 10 business days for P1. After PR merged, request retest slot.

shreya: Checklist for evidence handoff I'll own: list of assessor emails, presigned buckets, ephemeral creds windows, audit-log export runbook, KMS grant IDs. I'll post runbook by EOD Fri.

ops_lead: Noted. I'll pre-create S3 prefixes and a lifecycle that archives after 90 days.

matt: One more: we need to restrict KMS key usage to Decrypt only for assessors? They need to decrypt artifacts. We should NOT give Encrypt/Generate permissions. Use Grant with "Decrypt" and "Describe".

erin: Agreed. Also rotate test keys after engagement. Add KMS key wrapping note to runbook.

shreya: Thanks — action items: shreya(runbook & evidence list), matt(RBAC canary plan), erin(audit export + KMS grant template), ops_lead(presigned buckets + retest windows), samir(vuln board + triage matrix). Will sync Fri 4pm PT. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: /remind #eng-security "Pen-test pre-check sync" on 2027-04-09 16:00 PT

matt: Ack.

samir: Ack.

erin: Ack.
